title.en: AN ACT FIXING THE SALARY OF THE CHIEF STATISTICIAN.
title.orig: AN ACT FIXING THE SALARY OF THE CHIEF STATISTICIAN.

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_00031_1900_html.txt

text.en:
The animal salary of the chief statistician shall be three thousand five hundred dollars in money of
the United States.
This Act shall relate to the first day of October, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 24, 1900.
